n_hook.text: It's Saturday morning. Every chair is full, your hands are busy, and the phone keeps ringing.

n_cost.text: Each call you can't answer is a customer who quietly books somewhere else.

n_intro.text: Meet Ava, your receptionist from Receptly. She answers every call, day and night, in a warm, natural voice.

n_confirm.text: The booking goes straight into your calendar, and your customer gets a confirmation text right away.

n_waitlist.text: A reminder goes out the day before. If someone can't make it, the time is offered to the next person on your waitlist, so your chairs stay full.

n_team.text: Ava knows who is working and when, including days off and lunch breaks, so she only offers times that really work.

n_value.text: At a glance, you can see every call, and how much business Ava brought in, even while you were closed.

n_trust.text: She never double-books, never guesses, and passes callers to your team whenever they ask for a person.

n_setup.text: Getting started takes minutes. Add your hours, your team and your services, and Ava is ready.

n_outro.text: Receptly. Never miss a call, or a customer, again.

c1.text: Thank you for calling Luma Hair Studio, this is Ava. This call may be recorded and transcribed. How can I help you today?

c2.text: Hi! Could I book a haircut with Sara tomorrow afternoon?

c3.text: Of course. Sara has 2:30 or 4:00 tomorrow. Which would you prefer?

c5.text: Lovely. That's a haircut with Sara, tomorrow at 2:30, for Ayesha Khan. Shall I confirm it?

c7.text: You're all set! I've sent you a confirmation text. Is there anything else I can help with?
